title: User Playback State Contract
problem: Taru lacks a public server-authoritative User Playback State contract, so Android can only offer device-local resume and cannot correctly claim cross-device Continue Watching, watched state, or progress reporting.
gates: cargo nextest run -p taru-db -p taru-server user_playback_state --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: Freeze the public User Playback State contract and user principal semantics before implementation. Do not let Android local resume become cross-device Continue Watching.
